cards.prompt: **Volume is king**: Aim for ____+ hard sets per muscle group per week, distributed across 2-3 training sessions
cards.context: **Volume is king**: Aim for 10-20+ hard sets per muscle group per week, distributed across 2-3 training sessions

cards.prompt: **Load flexibility**: Both heavy (6-12 reps) and moderate (____+ reps) loads work equally well when taken close to failure (0-3 reps in reserve)
cards.context: **Load flexibility**: Both heavy (6-12 reps) and moderate (15-20+ reps) loads work equally well when taken close to failure (0-3 reps in reserve)

cards.prompt: **Mechanical tension drives growth**: Focus on full range of motion, controlled eccentrics (____ seconds), and maintaining tension throughout the lift
cards.context: **Mechanical tension drives growth**: Focus on full range of motion, controlled eccentrics (2-4 seconds), and maintaining tension throughout the lift

cards.prompt: **Failure isn't mandatory**: Training ____ reps from failure stimulates similar hypertrophy as training to complete failure with less fatigue
cards.context: **Failure isn't mandatory**: Training 0-3 reps from failure stimulates similar hypertrophy as training to complete failure with less fatigue

cards.prompt: **Progressive overload is essential**: Gradually increase volume, load, or reps over time through [[B1. ____]]
cards.context: **Progressive overload is essential**: Gradually increase volume, load, or reps over time through [[B1. Progressive Overload]]
